On Mon, Mar 6, 2017 at 9:19 AM, bic ton <bict...@gmail.com> wrote:
Hi All,
I have a table like this (this is just example I have hundreds of lines)
read.table("res.txt")
    V1  V2     V3
1  18  8       A
2  20  6       B
3  52  46     C

and a function like this

fun <- function(x) {
x=(x-a)/b
res= mean(x,na.rm=T)


and I have something that changes in my loop called fc

now if fc ="A"  excute fun using values:  a from V1 and b from V2  that correspond to A  and the the same for B until no the loop is finished.


Thanks

Bic

Yep, I'm not even sure what the question is. Are the values of V3 (A,
B, C) all distinct in your larger example? If so, it would seem you
could use something like:

which(table$V3 == fc)

to find the row of the table from which to select a and b. But as I
said, I don't yet understand the issue.
